integrity: All numerical finite-path checks are supporting tests, while the proof is analytic; no general claim about arbitrary defect configurations.
scientific_limitations: Infinite one-dimensional irreversible dimer process; two finite positive rate defects and intermediate-edge mean acceptance only. Closely relevant heterogeneous-substrate 1998 full text unavailable; equivalence and priority risk remains. No independent scientific validation.
title: Parity-signed nonlinear interference between two kinetic defects in one-dimensional dimer deposition
